faq.q: What can I do while I wait my turn?
faq.a: Breathe slowly, count quietly, cheer for the player, or plan your next move. Keeping busy makes the time feel shorter.
asks: Tell me about the Count to ten

faq.a: Frustrated means feeling cross because you cannot have or do something yet. It is a normal feeling, and it passes.
When you really want something, your brain wants it now. Waiting is a skill, like riding a bike, and it gets easier with practice.

faq.q: Is it okay to feel frustrated?
faq.a: Yes. Feelings are never wrong. What matters is what you do with them, like breathing instead of grabbing.
asks: Is it bad to get cross in a game?

faq.a: So everyone gets a fair go. Games only work if everyone gets to play, and people want to play again with someone who waits nicely.
asks: What is the point of taking turns?

facts: Ludo comes from pachisi, a board game that has been played in India for hundreds of years.
In the famous marshmallow studies at Stanford in the 1960s and 1970s, children used tricks like singing or covering their eyes to help them wait.
